environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has an AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached with three rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet at priority 1 in COUNT mode for baseline telemetry, (2) a custom rule group 'corp-input-validation' at priority 2 containing a RegexPatternSet match on query string values matching pattern `(?i)(?:union\s+select|;\s*(?:drop|alter|insert|update|delete)|'\s*(?:or|and)\s+['"]?\d|--\s*$)` with BLOCK action and label 'awswaf:managed:custom:sqli-pattern', (3) AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet at priority 3 with all rules in COUNT mode (used for detection metrics only, not blocking). The Fargate task uses a read-only root filesystem with an ephemeral tmpfs mount at /tmp. The task IAM role has no S3 or network egress permissions beyond the VPC. CloudWatch Container Insights enabled for observability.

config.compute: ECS Fargate with read-only root filesystem
config.waf_rule_2: Custom rule group 'corp-input-validation' priority=2 action=BLOCK, RegexPatternSet on query_string values: (?i)(?:union\s+select|;\s*(?:drop|alter|insert|update|delete)|'\s*(?:or|and)\s+['"']?\d|--\s*$)
config.task_iam_role: no s3/network egress beyond VPC endpoints
config.database: SQLite on ephemeral storage mounted at /var/lib/app/
